std::unique

template< class ForwardIt > ForwardIt unique( ForwardIt first, ForwardIt last );(1)
template< class ForwardIt, class BinaryPred > ForwardIt unique( ForwardIt first, ForwardIt last, BinaryPred p );(2)

Eliminates all but the first element from every consecutive group of equivalent elements.

Return value

Past-the-end iterator for the new logical end of the range.

Complexity

Exactly (last - first) - 1 comparisons.
